skill_name: Create a how-to guide for setting up a home Wi-fi network.
workflow: Setting up a home Wi-Fi network requires purchasing a router, connecting the router to an Internet provider, setting the router's administrative username and password, configuring the network's settings, such as security and the network name, and connecting devices to the network. First, purchase a router. Then, connect the router to your Internet provider and configure the connection. Next, set up your network's administrative username and password.
